title: Pasta with tomato-based sauce and meat, ready-to-heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with tomato-based sauce and meat is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. It contains pasta, a tomato sauce, pieces of selected meat and spices. Designed for convenient and tasty nutrition at any time.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tomato sauce is made from ripe tomatoes, giving the dish a bright flavor and aroma.
The meat is usually beef or pork, pre‑seared and seasoned with herbs.
The pasta is often fortified with B‑vitamins and iron, making it nutritionally rich.
The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or frozen for up to 3 months.
Heating typically takes 2–3 minutes in a microwave.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Meat and pasta provide complete protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Rich in complex carbohydrates
items.content: Pasta supplies sustained energy through complex carbs, helping maintain blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Tomato sauce offers vitamin C, lycopene and potassium, while the meat contributes iron and zinc.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Thermally processed ingredients make the meal soft and easy on the stomach.

items.title: Convenient and time‑saving
items.content: A ready‑made dish provides a complete meal quickly without cooking.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The tomato sauce can be salty; people monitoring sodium intake should consider portion size.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Wheat pasta contains gluten, making the product unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: Meat pieces may contain saturated fats; moderation is recommended.

items.title: Thermal safety
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave cold spots where bacteria could survive.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in a microwave (800 W) for 2–3 minutes, stirring halfway through. If needed, finish heating on the stovetop while stirring. Serve hot, optionally topped with grated cheese or fresh herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C for no more than 5 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C for up to 3 months. Ensure the packaging is intact before reheating.
